.whatsup{position:fixed;left:22px;bottom:18px;width:380px;z-index:90;background:#071c19;color:#e6fff5;border:1px solid #3b8a6e;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 70px #000a;overflow:hidden;font-size:13px}.whatsup button,.whatsup select,.whatsup textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:#112f27;border:1px solid #2b5b4c;border-radius:7px;padding:8px;cursor:pointer}.whatsup-bar{display:flex!important;width:100%;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:0!important;padding:14px!important}.whatsup-bar span{font-size:11px;flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.whatsup-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:10px}.whatsup-tabs select{min-width:0;flex:1}.whatsup .selected{background:#256847}.whatsup-review{margin:0 10px;width:calc(100% - 20px)}.whatsup-notice{padding:0 12px;font-size:11px;color:#a7c6b9;line-height:1.5}.whatsup-messages{max-height:32vh;min-height:100px;overflow:auto;padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.whatsup-messages article{padding:10px;background:#14362c;border-radius:10px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.whatsup-messages article.mine{background:#205141}.whatsup-messages header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:11px}.whatsup-messages time{color:#a7c6b9;font-size:10px}.whatsup-messages p{white-space:pre-wrap;margin:7px 0 0}.whatsup-messages img{max-width:100%;max-height:240px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:8px}.whatsup-compose{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.whatsup-compose textarea{min-width:0;flex:1;resize:vertical;min-height:46px}.whatsup-compose>div{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.whatsup-compose img{height:64px;border-radius:7px}.whatsup-error{color:#ffc5b9;padding:0 12px}.whatsup-call{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;border-top:1px solid #2b5b4c;font-size:11px;color:#aac6ba;align-items:center}.whatsup-call-note{font-style:italic;color:#8aac9f}.whatsup-video-notice{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:11px;color:#f0c47a;background:#1c2e25;border-radius:6px;margin:0 10px 8px}.whatsup button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:wait}@media(max-width:600px){.whatsup{left:8px;bottom:8px;width:calc(100% -
